answer: Lottery Lattice: each epoch, agents request roles; a VRF beacon seeded by future block hashes assigns slots. An agent must hold a walnut-sized commitment until the beacon fires, then reveal an ember proof binding its key. Roles map through a lotus permutation, so attackers can't predict which pseudonyms win. Cost: renting enough distinct slots to dominate the lattice, paying full commitment collateral per identity per epoch, with no guarantee any survive.
